Indonesian Papua is under a higher advisory of 'Avoid non-essential travel' except for Raja Ampat Regency and Sorong city due to violent incidents, militant threats, and kidnapping risks.

summary: Thailand is under an overall advisory of 'Exercise a high degree of caution' due to ongoing political tensions, sporadic demonstrations, and a threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include the Thailand-Cambodia border (avoid all travel due to ongoing tensions and land mines) and the southern provinces of Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, and southern Songkhla (avoid all travel due to violent attacks by separatist insurgents). Political instability and military enforcement powers contribute to an unpredictable security environment.

summary: The Government of Canada advises exercising a high degree of caution in Türkiye due to the threat of terrorist attacks and the possibility of demonstrations throughout the country. Avoid all travel to within 10 km of the borders with Iraq and Syria due to the unpredictable security situation and terrorism threat. Avoid non-essential travel to the southeastern provinces of Hakkari and Şirnak due to the ongoing security risks.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: The Government of Canada advises Canadians to exercise a high degree of caution in Egypt due to ongoing regional tensions, an unpredictable security situation, and the threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include Northern Sinai (avoid all travel due to terrorist activity and military operations), the Western Desert and Libyan border area (avoid all travel due to smuggling, terrorist activities, and armed groups), and the northern part of South Sinai (avoid non-essential travel due to terrorism).

The Government of Canada advises avoiding non-essential travel to Kuwait due to a volatile security situation in the region, including missile and drone attacks striking civilian infrastructure. There is an ongoing threat of terrorism, particularly near foreign military installations and places of worship. The border area with Iraq is under a higher warning, with all travel advised against within 5 km of the border due to unexploded ordnance from the 1991 Gulf War.

The Government of Canada advises avoiding non-essential travel to Israel due to the volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity and potential travel disruptions. Specific areas with higher warnings include Jerusalem (avoid non-essential travel), the Golan Heights bordering Syria (avoid all travel), the area within 5 km of the Lebanon border (avoid all travel), and the area within 10 km of the Gaza Strip border (avoid all travel). The advisory also highlights severe humanitarian conditions and infrastructure damage in the Gaza Strip.
